notes:
- Account: Cobalt Arc Digital (payments / fraud analytics). Very security-sensitive: "must hold our keys" on first call.
- Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed keys (BYOK) + HSM attestation + full audit trail.
- KMS requirements discussed: support for AWS KMS (CMKs + envelope encryption), AWS CloudHSM option for FIPS-backed keys, Azure Key Vault integration (managed identity + Key Vault references), GCP KMS with IAM service account and CMEK, and an option to import keys for BYOK workflows.
- Crypto flow notes: prefer envelope encryption where Redwood stores only encrypted DEKs; master CMK never exported from customer KMS. Key rotation policy: monthly rotation preferred, must support automatic rewrap without downtime.
- HSM specifics: customer requested validation of FIPS 140-2/3 attestation, HSM key usage logs, and support for PKCS#11 for on-prem HSMs. Asked if Redwood Private can call a customer HSM via VPN / private link; SE said gateway mode possible in POC.
- Audit logging: need key-access logs forwarded to Splunk/Datadog and retention for 7 years for compliance; CloudTrail + KeyVault diagnostic logs acceptable. Need proof that all key operations (Decrypt/Sign/Wrap) are logged with key identifiers and requester identity.
- Data residency: primary EU customers require all inference logs and cached KV to stay in eu-west-1; Redwood to confirm that cache eviction and persistent storage can be restricted per-region.
- Integration notes from SE call: AWS KMS: use IAM role+sts for cross-account CMK access; option for CloudHSM-backed CMK; Azure: Managed identity + user-assigned MI pattern; GCP: service account with member/cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter role.
- POC ask: 2-week Private VPC trial (staging) with customer CMK in their AWS account and CloudHSM-backed CMK test, demo of key rotation rewrap, and audit log export to their Splunk instance.
- Pricing sensitivity: wants dedicated capacity estimate (1-2x p99 targets) before procurement. Estimated ARR bucket acceptable.
- Quote from Head of Security: "No plaintext keys out of our control, and logs must show every key usage."
- Next internal asks: provide BYOK addendum template, HSM attestation PDF, and step-by-step runbook for KMS integration + troubleshooting.
- Caveats: legal requires indemnity language for key compromise scenarios; procurement timeline ~6 weeks after POC signoff.
